slides.title: how far below average the meher harvest could be
slides.body: After a kiremt season that was the driest on record in many areas, FEWS NET says.

slides.title: crop yield losses in lowland Hararghe
slides.body: Estimated for lowland East and West Hararghe, versus 10-20% in midland and highland areas.

slides.title: Tigray's safety net is on pause
slides.body: The PSNP safety net remains paused in Tigray and is expected to stay paused through at least May 2027.

slides.title: rations for long-registered refugees
slides.body: In Gambela, around 40,000 arrivals in Tormorok received a one-month ration in July.

slides.title: Some relief in the south
slides.body: Deyr/hageya rains are improving pasture and water, but many pastoral areas remain in Crisis (IPC Phase 3).
